soop-stroke-sub342-native.title: Inspect complete source MRI arrays and three separate mask boundaries
soop-stroke-sub342-native.caption: One released SOOP source case, sub-342: complete TRACE, ADC, T1 and FLAIR storage arrays, plus three separate original acute, chronic and combined masks. Inspect native planes, original voxel values and literal mask sampling-cell boundaries. Acquisition timing, treatment state, calibrated ADC clinical units, cross-sequence registration, named-anatomy coverage and clinical tissue boundaries remain unverified. Label volume is not pretreatment infarct core or irreversible tissue.
soop-stroke-sub342-native.attribution: Rorden, Absher and Newman-Norlund. Stroke Outcome Optimization Project (SOOP), OpenNeuro ds004889 v1.1.2. CC0. Source images and three source labels unchanged; lossless transport and literal voxel-cell geometry added.
